summary: Good types and a tiny footprint, but releases are not built or published by CI: the repository has no .github directory at all. Fails the release-integrity constraint.
reasoning: The repository root contains no .github directory, so there is no CI or publish workflow; 8.0.0 has no provenance attestation.
Zero runtime dependencies and a 32 KB install.
Type inference flattens nested objects but drops optionality and widens conflicts to a union.
Safe against CVE-2026-93753 and active as of May 2026.
caveats: Publishing from a developer machine means no verifiable link between the GitHub commit and the npm tarball.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: No .github directory in the repository; no workflows of any kind. Release is manual.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Nested objects flatten correctly, but optionality is lost and conflicting scalars widen to a union.
